component.name: ComfyUI Flatpak (Unofficial)
component.summary: Unofficial Flatpak for the ComfyUI node-based AI generation interface

description.p: ComfyUI is a powerful node-based interface and execution engine for AI image, video, audio, and model workflows.
This is an unofficial community Flatpak package. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by ComfyUI or Comfy Org.
This Flatpak packages ComfyUI with NVIDIA-focused GPU support, ComfyUI-Manager, git, pip, and uv so custom nodes can be installed into a sandboxed user extension layer.
Model weights are not bundled. Place models under the app data model folders or configure extra model paths.
Update ComfyUI to 0.26.0 and run custom-node relative model downloads from the writable Flatpak data directory.
Initial unofficial Flatpak package for ComfyUI 0.24.0.
